subject: Your account has been limited
body:
Dear customer,

We noticed unusual activity on your account. Your account will be suspended within 24 hours unless you verify your account immediately.

Click here to confirm your identity: http://paypa1-secure.com/webscr/login/verify

PayPal Security Team

subject: Mailbox storage full - action required
body:
Dear user,

Your mailbox has exceeded its storage limit. To avoid losing emails, re-validate your mailbox by entering your username and password at the link below within 48 hours.

https://bit.ly/3mailbox-fix

Failure to do so will result in your account being deactivated.

subject: Payment declined for order #112-8834
body: Hello, Your recent payment was declined. Please update your payment and billing information to avoid cancellation of your order. https://www.amazon.com/your-orders Thank you for shopping with us.

subject: Congratulations! You have won $850,000
body: Congratulations! You have won the international email lottery. To claim your prize, send your full name, bank account number and routing number to our claims agent. A small processing fee is required via gift card or bitcoin.

subject: Overdue invoice attached
body:
Hi,

Please review the overdue invoice in the attached file Invoice_0921.docm. If the document does not display correctly, click Enable Content.

body:
Dear taxpayer,
